# pyteomics test files

Copied unmodified from the [pyteomics](https://github.com/levitsky/pyteomics)
test suite (`tests/`), licensed under the Apache License 2.0 (see `LICENSE`).

| File | Used by |
|---|---|
| `test.pep.xml` | pepXML importer oracle (mixed SEQUEST/Mascot/X!Tandem/Inspect hits) |
| `test.mzid` | mzIdentML importer oracle (PSI "MPC_use_case_handcrafted" example) |
| `tiny.pwiz.1.1.mzML`, `test.mgf` | spectra importers |

Expected values in Tuffold's tests are derived by hand from these files.
